catalysts.headline: Trump-Xi summit in Washington Thursday 09-24 (Xi's first US visit since 2015): agenda is tariff-truce extension (truce runs to 11-10), critical minerals/rare earths, chips export controls, and a proposed US-China AI dialogue; Nvidia's Huang, OpenAI's Altman, Qualcomm's Amon, Microsoft's Nadella and Tim Cook attend the White House dinner
catalysts.magnitude: Analysts expect an incremental outcome, not a reset: tariff burden held near ~20%, meaningful US concessions on advanced-chip export controls 'unlikely', truce checkpoint before the 11-10 expiry. Two-sided: a tariff/truce extension is a tailwind for the semicap/foundry sleeve; new AI-chip or SME controls, or a rare-earth retaliation, would hit AMAT/KLAC/LRCX/ASML China revenue first. Nothing in the sources quantifies a control change; this is a dated event risk, not a measured threat.

catalysts.headline: Nvidia-OpenAI vendor financing stays the standing financing-structure overhang: Nvidia backing up to $105bn for OpenAI's Ohio datacentre (4.25GW initial, +3.75GW option, SB Energy builds, 20-yr lease), plus talks on financing up to ~$350bn of OpenAI chip purchases on top of $30bn already invested
catalysts.magnitude: Restated as a lasting fact, not new this window (CNBC 08-17; the 07-27 $250bn backstop talks preceded it). Supports demand for chips and memory (tailwind) while concentrating counterparty risk in one customer (threat); the $350bn figure comes from a search-summary paraphrase and is unverified. No new financing headline found today.

catalysts.headline: Semis rally 09-21: SOX up >2% to its highest since 09-09 on oil falling below $100 and the 10y easing to just under 5%, into the Trump-Xi summit; no company-specific catalyst named
catalysts.magnitude: SMH 573.00 -> 584.69 (+2.04%, market_inputs primary series); US10Y 4.998 -> 4.967 (-3.1bp, market_inputs). Oil 'below $100' is a news paraphrase with no two-print check, so it is NOT used as a classified mechanism. Rebound partly reverses the 09-14 -4.75% SMH day; no fundamental change.
